description: This file is a shell script that manages Git submodule updates, testing various scenarios of submodule states and transitions within a Git repository. It includes detailed functions for setting up repositories, testing submodule states, and performing operations to verify correct behavior during submodule updates, replacements, removals, and recursive updates.

methods.name: create_lib_submodule_repo
methods.description: Sets up a main repository with multiple submodules and commits, defining various submodule states for testing.

methods.name: replace_gitfile_with_git_dir
methods.description: Replaces the .git file in a submodule with a .git directory, simulating a submodule with a separate git directory.

methods.name: test_git_directory_is_unchanged
methods.description: Checks whether the submodule's .git directory and core.worktree settings are unchanged.

methods.name: test_git_directory_exists
methods.description: Verifies whether the .git directory for a submodule exists and is configured correctly.

methods.name: prolog
methods.description: Prepares the environment for tests, creating repositories if needed and setting Git configs.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to
methods.description: Resets the working tree to a specific commit, initializing submodules accordingly.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to_interested
methods.description: Resets the working tree, including submodules, and configures submodule URLs.

methods.name: test_superproject_content
methods.description: Checks that the superproject's working tree matches a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_content
methods.description: Checks that a submodule at a path contains the content of a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_recursing_with_args_common
methods.description: Performs common submodule tests with recursive options enabled, checking various submodule state transitions.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on submodule switching operations using a provided command.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch
methods.description: Tests switching submodules using a given Git command.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch
methods.description: Tests forced switching of submodules, allowing local changes to be discarded.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Tests recursive submodule switch operations on various transition scenarios.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Tests recursive, forced submodule switching, allowing discarding local changes and handling complex transitions.
